The '''Duinarbulon Star Lancers''' were elite [[Horse/Legends|mounted]] warriors recruited from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duinarbulon]] who served the [[Kingdom of Cron]] and the [[Xim's empire|Empire]] of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]].<ref name="Xim Week">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref><ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-3-xim-the-despot|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 3 - "Xim the Despot"}}</ref><ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==History==
Originally warriors for the Kingdom of Cron, the Star Lancers came into the service of [[Xer VIII]] following his takeover of the Kingdom, and later served [[Xim's empire|the empire]] of Xer's son, [[Xim/Legends|Xim]].<ref name="Xim Week" /><ref name="Author's Cut" />

They fought for Xim on a number of worlds during the [[Xim Wars|wars with the Hutts]], but were eventually defeated during the [[Second Battle of Vontor]] in about [[25,100 BBY]] after Xim abandoned the battlefield to escape with a haul of precious [[Vontor]]ian [[Kiirium/Legends|kiirium]]. During the engagement, the Star Lancers were overrun by [[Jilruan/Legends|Jilruan]] [[flecheteer]]s mounted atop [[Cyborrean battlemount]]s, [[Weequay/Legends|Weequays]], and [[Cyborrean]] heavy infantry.<ref name="Author's Cut" /><ref name="Warfare" />

Legend had it that seven massive monoliths of polished [[ebon]] marked the Star Lancers' parade grounds.<ref name="Xim Week" /> These had long-since vanished by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and [[Ximology|Ximologists]] considered the "[[Parade Grounds]]" that then existed on Duinarbulon to be obvious fakes that no soldier of Xim had ever set foot on.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Duinarbulon Star Lancers were considered to be a myth. During the [[Mount Tantiss dig|recovery operations]] surrounding [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] following the [[assault on Mount Tantiss]], [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologists]] believed they had found the [[Duinarbulon Stones]]. Lead archaeologist [[Garv Debble]] was excited at the prospect as the discovery of the Stones would be the first proof that the Star Lancers were, indeed, real. However, the [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] thought to be the gems were not the Duinarbulon Stones.<ref name="EAT">{{WEGCite|story=Erasing All Traces|book=The Last Command Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref>

==Equipment==
The [[Croke]] poet [[Asenec]] of [[Crakull]] described in detail the Star Lancers' equipment in his poem "[[The Gleam of Kiirium]]." A Star Lancer was armored with a gloss-black coat of ionic mail made from kiirium ceramic, designed to reflect [[Laser/Legends|laserfire]] back on to the enemy. The death's head emblem of Xim's empire was embroidered on the coat. The Star Lancers were mounted atop [[Galdrian mustang]]s.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

The Lancers were armed with a [[Duinarbulon]]-made [[Spear/Legends|lance]], with a handgrip made from [[Raxan seaweed]] and a reflective [[Wiktionary:vamplate|vamplate]] to protect the hand, also made of kiirium. The point was poisoned with [[Malkite themfar/Legends|malkite themfar]].<ref name="Author's Cut" /> The Star Lancers were additionally armed with [[Beam tube/Legends|beam tubes]], distant ancestors of the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. Beam tubes were bulky and slow to fire, with contemporary [[Power cell/Legends|power packs]] offering only one hundred shots, so beam-tubers alternated fire by [[Squad/Legends|squad]] and carried large [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]] on [[Hoversled/Legends|hoversleds]]. Nevertheless, they were much safer to carry and required less maintenance than the [[heatbeam]]s and [[Plasma cannon/Legends|plasma cannons]] carried by the rest of Xim's military.<ref name="Warfare" />
